page.layout: One printed page of text, with a running head at the top, a dedicatory letter in roman and italic type, a closing signature line, and a list of names and index-like lines on the right side in a mirrored show-through area. No marginal notes. The lower right block of short lines is an index-like list of Latin words and numbers (partly show-through from the reverse side).

main_text.p: ex tui nominis nuncupatione in huius Operis frontispicio conspecta apud pios omnes accessuram puto. Hoc autem munus meum, ut tam gratum habeas, quàm tibi candido beneuolóque animo à me offertur, obse-cro, Vir præstantissime, & me [?] tuum esse perpetuò censeto. Vale.
Orthesij, Calend. Octob. CIↃ. IↃ. XC.
main_text.head: DANAEVS.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page covers much of the lower right block and the left column; the index lines are largely illegible. The name list is partly garbled by bleed-through. Heading "DANAEVS." is set in large spaced capitals. Greek word "χρίσται"-like fragment in the dedication line is uncertain and not transcribed.
